title: Research project title
subtitle: A short statement of the research question and why it matters.
overview: Introduce the scientific problem, the systems you study, and the gap this project addresses. Give readers a clear reason to care about the question.
Describe your approach and the contribution you aim to make. Connect the underlying theory with the application, and explain what a successful outcome would enable.

objectives.title: Understand the system
objectives.text: State the first research objective and the question it will answer.

objectives.title: Develop the methods
objectives.text: Describe the control, estimation, or optimization methods you will develop.

objectives.title: Connect theory to practice
objectives.text: Explain how you will evaluate the methods and where the results will be used.
